nina: Great all-hands today — below are concise follow-ups from the live Q&A plus a couple of clarifications folks asked for. Recording + notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/all-hands/mar-2026.

nina: Short action list (reply with :white_check_mark: when you pick one):
- SLA sample language for sales decks -> @eli
- Simple burst pricing example + toy calculator -> @tess
- Private deployment ETA + checklist -> @oscar
- Model quantization migration doc -> @priya

tess: For the toy calculator, do we want a single-file JS snippet or a small spreadsheet + link?

eli: A one-file JS snippet is great for demos, add a spreadsheet for sales ops. I'll take SLA wording.

oscar: I'll own Private deploy ETA. I'll open INF-4390 and tag security/legal for cert timelines.

priya: For quant migration guide I can include quick commands and a short perf table. Can someone paste a representative FP16 baseline for 13B?

ops-bot: recording-bot: uploaded 2026-03-allhands.mp4 (duration 00:52:10) -> https://internal.redwood/rec/1951234567.mp4

nina: Note re: "same dev experience": when we said parity across Hosted/Dedicated/Private we mean the public APIs and Console flows are consistent. Customers should expect infra-level knobs (node sizing, network, KMS). Use this exact phrasing for external comms.

tess: noted, I'll add that line to the pricing FAQ.

eli: I'll draft the SLA sample tonight; will include failure mode examples and credit table.

oscar: INF-4390 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4390 1 - assigning to infra eng. ETA: next Wed for initial checklist.

priya: I'll post a gist with commands later today. sample: `./run_bench.sh --model redwood-13b --precision int8 --batch 1 --seq 512`

nina: Can people drop slide refs that need extra context? I'll append to public notes.

eli: slide 12 1 add a short note clarifying SLA exclusions (force majeure, planned maintenance windows).

oscar: slide 27 1 I'll update the private deploy diagram with the VPN/NAT steps. attaching to INF-4390.

nina: Thanks all. Please post a one-line ownership confirmation here (and react :white_check_mark:) so I can close this thread and ensure items move into tickets.
